Title: Tanay's Little Adventure

Cast

1. Tanay - 11 years, son
Look: yellow T-shirt, blue shorts
2. Sunita - 42 years, mother
Look: yellow kurta, jeans

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The park - green grass, swings, benches

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Tanay stands in the courtyard. Sunita stands near him.]

Tanay: "Let's do something fun today."

[A dust storm sweeps across the village.]

Sunita (gently): "Well done!"

[Tanay lights a bonfire.]

Tanay: "What next?"

Scene 2: The park - Day

[Tanay stands in the park. Sunita stands near him.]

Sunita: "So, here we are!"

[Tanay catches the ball.]

Tanay: "I knew it!"

[Tanay swings on the swing.]

Tanay: "Okay, Mom."

[Tanay feeds the birds.]

Sunita: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
